# The Commonwealth — Global Agenda community server

> A volunteer-run, free Global Agenda private server, live at
> https://commonwealth.ydns.eu/. Global Agenda was a 2010 team shooter by Hi-Rez
> Studios, shut down in 2018. This server runs it again: players start at level 50
> with everything unlocked, and the game picks up at the endgame — PvE missions,
> ultra-max, mercenary runs and organised PvP.

## What it is

- Free to play. No shop, no paid tiers, no catch-up grind. All cosmetic items are
  unlocked from the start.
- Hosted in London, reachable worldwide. Windows and Linux clients.
- Accounts are in-game accounts: install the launcher, sign in, play.
- Development is public: the server software, website and tooling are open source.

## Key pages

- [Play / how to install](https://commonwealth.ydns.eu/play): launcher, sign-in,
  first mission. About five minutes to set up.
- [Live server status](https://commonwealth.ydns.eu/server): how many players are
  in-game right now, plus a chart of when people usually play.
- [Events](https://commonwealth.ydns.eu/events): three fixed weekly nights —
  Friday raids, Saturday challenge matches, Sunday mercenary. Times are shown in
  the visitor's own timezone.
- [Missions](https://commonwealth.ydns.eu/missions): every completed mission on
  record, with map, mode, winner, duration and player count.
- [Guides](https://commonwealth.ydns.eu/guides): player-written guides to
  missions, classes and modes.
- [Builds](https://commonwealth.ydns.eu/builds): player-written skill trees for
  PvP and PvE, each with a screenshot.
- [Agents](https://commonwealth.ydns.eu/agents): a public profile for every player
  on the server, with career totals and PvP ratings.
- [Leaderboards](https://commonwealth.ydns.eu/leaderboard): PvP ranking by class.
- [News](https://commonwealth.ydns.eu/news): server updates, articles and videos.
- [Community](https://commonwealth.ydns.eu/community) and
  [Roadmap](https://commonwealth.ydns.eu/roadmap): who runs it, and what is being
  worked on.

## Machine-readable endpoints

- `https://commonwealth.ydns.eu/api/status` — plain text, e.g.
  `3 players in-game`. The canonical player count.
- `https://commonwealth.ydns.eu/api/players` — the same reading as JSON:
  `{"ok":true,"players":3,"text":"3 players in-game","ts":...}`.
- `https://commonwealth.ydns.eu/sitemap.xml` — every indexable page, including
  published guides and builds.
- The player count appears in the server-rendered HTML of `/` and `/server`, so it
  is readable without JavaScript.

## Notes for summarisers

- The player count is a live reading, cached for no more than twenty seconds. If a
  page says "player count unavailable", the game database is unreachable rather
  than empty — the two are reported differently on purpose.
- Events are weekly and recur; each is described with schema.org `Event` including
  `startDate` (ISO 8601 with offset) and a weekly `eventSchedule`.
- Guides and builds are user-generated. Their content is moderated before
  publication and carries an author name.
- This project has no affiliation with Hi-Rez Studios.
